evidence.reason: Changed metering.evaluate arguments from (units, 0.1, "monthly") to (units, 0, "benchmark") and added +3 to the return value, altering the charge calculation semantics.
Swapped priorities array from [multiplier, multiplier/2] to [multiplier/2, multiplier], changing the effective multiplier used in the return expression from multiplier to multiplier/2.
chargeUnit is referenced by both subscriptionCharge and usageCharge, coupling the two edits through shared metering state.
Test only asserts subscriptionCharge(40) > 0, not exact values, so the merged numeric behavior is not validated.

result.userExplanation: 两处修改分别改变了订阅计费的参数与用量计费的乘数优先级，且共享 chargeUnit 状态，合并后可能产生非预期的计费结果，但现有测试仅验证正数，证据不足以完全确认。
result.suggestedAction: 请 src/subscription.ts 的 subscriptionCharge 作者确认将 evaluate 参数从 (units, 0.1, "monthly") 改为 (units, 0, "benchmark") 并加 3 是否有意为之；同时请 src/metering.ts 的 usageCharge 作者确认 priorities 数组顺序交换是否与订阅计费的新参数兼容，必要时恢复原顺序或同步调整调用方。
